title_en: Saving Water, Losing Sleep
title_zh: 省了水，賠上睡眠
story_zh: 受到安地斯山脈地形與降雨的限制，玻利維亞的農民開始嘗試用噴灌種植作物。可是噴頭數量有限，農民必須在不同高度的坡地之間反覆搬動噴頭，才能讓所有作物平均得到水。最適合噴灌的時間是風最小、蒸發最少的凌晨三、四點，農民經常得半夜起床。同時，推廣人員很少到田間實際示範，家中真正負責灌溉的婦女，只能在缺乏完整教學的情況下邊做邊學。最後省下來的水，換成了被犧牲的睡眠和勞力。推動農業技術時，該考量的不只是效率，還有性別與角色分工，以及技術的學習曲線。
story_en: Constrained by the terrain and rainfall of the Andes, farmers in Bolivia began experimenting with sprinkler irrigation. With only a few sprinkler heads, they have to carry them back and forth between plots at different heights on the slope so that every crop gets an even share of water. The best time to irrigate is three or four in the morning, when the wind is calmest and evaporation lowest, so farmers often have to get up in the middle of the night. Extension workers rarely demonstrate the technology in the field, which leaves the women who actually do the irrigating at home to learn by trial and error. In the end, the water saved is paid for with lost sleep and extra labour. Introducing an agricultural technology should therefore be about more than efficiency: it must also account for gender, the division of roles within the household, and how hard the technology is to learn.
note: Atlas/🇧🇴 Bolivia – Smallholder Sprinkler Adoption

title_en: Feeding Soil with Local Agri-Food Waste
title_zh: 用在地農食殘渣養回土壤
story_zh: 希臘西馬其頓曾是褐煤能源重鎮，在歐盟與希臘的政策目標下，預計在 2028 年告別燃煤。農業逐漸成為當地的經濟支柱，但過去採礦留下的重金屬，加上地中海型氣候強烈的淋溶作用，讓土壤養分不斷流失，農民只能依賴昂貴的化學肥料。Waste4Soil 計畫因此把當地食品加工業的副產品，經過沼氣發電後剩下的殘渣，做成堆肥和回收肥料，讓碳和養分回到田裡。不過目前的討論多半停在處理效率，這些產品對土壤肥力的實際效果，以及農民願不願意使用，都還在研究當中。
story_en: West Macedonia was once Greece's lignite power hub, and under EU and Greek policy targets it is expected to phase out coal by 2028. Agriculture is becoming the backbone of the local economy, but heavy metals left by mining, combined with strong leaching under the Mediterranean climate, keep draining nutrients from the soil, leaving farmers dependent on expensive chemical fertilisers. The Waste4Soil project turns by-products from local food processing, the residues left after biogas production, into compost and recycled fertilisers, so that carbon and nutrients return to the fields. So far, though, the discussion has focused mostly on processing efficiency; the real effects on soil fertility, and whether farmers are willing to use these products, are still being studied.
note: Atlas/🇬🇷 West Macedonia – Food Waste to Soil Improvers

sources.text: Waste4Soil. Living Lab Northern Greece – Region of West Macedonia.
MARGIN-UP. Greek use case.

title_en: Murky Water Starving a Lake's Ecology
title_zh: 湖水混濁拖垮整座湖的生態
story_zh: 荷蘭的馬肯湖原本是 1930 年代起的填海造陸計畫留下的人工湖。2004 年政府決定不再填海後，這片七、八萬公頃的水域就失去了明確的規劃。湖底的泥沙太細軟，很容易被攪得混濁，加上養分不足和外來種貽貝的影響，水草根本長不出來。這樣的生態狀況達不到歐盟 Natura 2000 與水架構指令（WFD）的標準，連周邊城市的開發計畫（例如興建新港口）也因此受限。為了解開「生態卡住開發」的困局，荷蘭的水利單位、地方政府和環保團體決定聯手：依照不同湖區規劃各自的功能，並放棄耗資 60 億歐元的巨型工程，改用每四年一步步調整的小型改善方案，先把生態救起來，再替城市發展爭取合法的開發空間。
story_en: The Markermeer is an artificial lake left behind by the land reclamation plans that began in the 1930s. After the government decided in 2004 not to reclaim it, these 70,000 to 80,000 hectares of water were left without a clear plan. The lake bed is covered with fine, soft silt that is easily stirred up, and together with a lack of nutrients and invasive mussels, this keeps water plants from growing at all. Because the ecology falls short of the EU's Natura 2000 and Water Framework Directive standards, development around the lake, such as a new port, has been held back too. To break this deadlock between ecology and development, Dutch water authorities, local governments and environmental groups joined forces: they assigned different functions to different parts of the lake and dropped a six-billion-euro mega-project in favour of small improvements adjusted step by step every four years. The idea is to restore the ecology first, and in doing so make legal room for the cities to grow.
note: Atlas/🇳🇱 Markermeer – Lake Ecological Decline

title_en: Farming Livelihoods under Climate Goals
title_zh: 減碳目標與酪農生計的拉扯
story_zh: 荷蘭的 Zegveld 是一大片泥炭地，也是酪農業的重鎮。這裡的土地就像一塊海綿，田間溝渠的水位是控制海綿乾濕的關鍵，而水位高低由當地民選的水利會決定。過去為了讓土地夠乾、讓大型農機能下田，溝渠水位被壓在地表下 60 到 80 公分，但泥炭接觸空氣後會慢慢分解、排放溫室氣體，土地也跟著下陷。把水位拉高到地表下 20 到 40 公分雖然能減少排放，酪農卻擔心收入會大幅減少。水位調高或調低，沒有一個選項能讓所有人滿意：氣候目標、糧食生產和農民生計緊緊綁在一起，解決一個難題，往往又製造出另一個困境。
story_en: Zegveld in the Netherlands is a large peatland and a centre of dairy farming. The land works like a sponge, and the water level in the ditches between fields controls how wet or dry that sponge is; the level itself is decided by the locally elected water board. To keep the land dry enough for heavy machinery, ditch water has long been held 60 to 80 centimetres below the surface. But once peat is exposed to air it slowly decomposes, releasing greenhouse gases, and the land subsides. Raising the water to 20 to 40 centimetres below the surface would cut emissions, yet dairy farmers fear it would sharply reduce their income. Neither raising nor lowering the water satisfies everyone: climate goals, food production and farmers' livelihoods are tightly bound together, and solving one problem often creates another.
note: Atlas/🇳🇱 Zegveld – Peat Subsidence and Emissions

title_en: Drought Exposes Unequal Access to Water
title_zh: 乾旱放大的用水不平等
story_zh: 摩洛哥的塔德拉灌溉區，渠道送來的水常常不夠作物用，農民只好抽地下水，地下水位一年年下降。但缺水的經驗並不平均：只能依賴渠道配水的小農，乾旱時輪灌間隔可能從十天拉長到二十天，只好種穀物、養牲畜分散風險；資本雄厚的出口農場，則用滴灌種柑橘。我用衛星氣候資料估算作物需水量，發現這裡的問題不只是缺水，而是誰有能力面對缺水。
story_en: In the Tadla irrigation scheme in Morocco, the water delivered by canals often falls short of what crops need. To fill the gap, farmers pump groundwater, and the water table keeps dropping. Modernisation programmes backed by the World Bank promote drip irrigation and high-value crops, but many smallholders cannot afford them. Using satellite climate data, I estimated how much water the crops actually need. The deeper problem is not only scarcity, but who is able to cope with it.
note: Atlas/🇲🇦 Tadla – Irrigation Supply vs Crop Demand

sources.text: Boularbah, S., Kuper, M., Hammani, A., Mailhol, J.-C., & Taky, A. (2019). The blind angle: Performance assessment of drip irrigation-in-use in a large-scale irrigation scheme in Morocco. Irrigation and Drainage, 68(5), 925–936.

title_en: A Shared Lake Enclosed for the Few
title_zh: 公共湖泊變成少數人的漁場
story_zh: 柬埔寨的洞里薩湖每年隨著湄公河的洪水漲退，這股節奏養活了大量的魚，也養活了靠湖維生的漁民。但國家把湖面切成一塊塊商業漁區租給業者，小漁民能捕魚的地方越來越少；上游的水壩，又改變了魚賴以為生的洪水節奏。學者把這種過程稱為「掠奪式積累」：公共的資源被圈起來，變成少數人的利益。可是魚會游動，不像土地能被圍住，這讓水上的圈地變得更加複雜。
story_en: Every year, the Tonle Sap lake in Cambodia swells and shrinks with the Mekong flood, feeding huge numbers of fish and the families who live from them. The state divided parts of the lake into commercial fishing lots and leased them out, leaving less room for small-scale fishers. Upstream, dams are changing the rhythm of the flood that the fish depend on. Unlike land, fish move, so enclosing them is never simple. This case showed me how food, water and power are tied together on a single lake.
note: Atlas/🇰🇭 Tonle Sap – Fisheries Enclosure

sources.text: Sneddon, C. (2007). Nature's materiality and the circuitous paths of accumulation: Dispossession of freshwater fisheries in Cambodia. Antipode, 39(1), 167–193.

title_en: One Canal, Four Competing Claims
title_zh: 一條水路，四方在爭
story_zh: 在泰國清邁的城郊，一套古老的灌溉水系，同時被看成農田水路、城市排水與傾倒垃圾的地方、防洪設施，以及社區的信仰網絡。研究者訪談了三十二個人，用「水社會領域」的概念和反向製圖，畫出不同的人如何爭奪同一片水景，也讓被邊緣化的聲音被看見。我讀完之後想問：把這些地圖疊在一起之後，能不能再用空間分析說明，誰在哪裡、為什麼承受了改變？
story_en: On the edge of Chiang Mai, Thailand, an old irrigation system is seen in four different ways at once. For farmers it carries water to fields, for the city it drains sewage, for planners it controls floods, and for communities it is part of a spiritual network. Researchers used the idea of a hydrosocial territory to show how power and competing visions reshape the same waterscape. Their maps put these claims side by side, but overlap alone cannot explain who loses and why. In my critique, I asked how spatial analysis could turn these overlapping stories into clearer causes and better decisions.
note: Output/Notes/Hydrosocial Territory

sources.text: Chayakul, J., Veldwisch, G. J., Bruins, B., & Boelens, R. (2026). Contested waters: Hydrosocial territories and power dynamics in the landscape of peri-urban Chiang Mai, Thailand. Geoforum, 169, 104457.

title_en: Drip Irrigation Pumps More Water
title_zh: 滴灌反而抽更多水
story_zh: 在摩洛哥的賽斯平原，政府補助農民改用滴灌，希望節省地下水。滴灌讓灌溉更有效率，也更有利可圖，農民反而擴大種植面積、改種更耗水的作物，抽出的地下水比以前更多。這就是「效率悖論」：我們施加的解方沒有解決問題，反而和真正的問題背道而馳。我第一次遇到它是在伊朗的案例，後來才明白，一塊田省下來的水，不一定會留在整個流域裡。
story_en: On the Saïss plain in Morocco, the government subsidised drip irrigation to help farmers save groundwater. Drip made irrigation more efficient, and also more profitable. Farmers used the savings to expand their fields and grow thirstier, high-value crops. In the end, more groundwater was pumped than before. This is the efficiency paradox: water saved on one field does not necessarily stay in the ground.
note: Atlas/🇲🇦 Saïss Plain – Drip Irrigation Paradox

sources.text: Benouniche, M., Kuper, M., Hammani, A., & Boesveld, H. (2014). Making the user visible: Analysing irrigation practices and farmers' logic to explain actual drip irrigation performance. Irrigation Science, 32, 405–420.

title_en: Investors Pushing Irrigation Past Its Borders
title_zh: 把灌區邊界往外推的投資者
story_zh: 葡萄牙南部的阿連特茹，原本是乾燥的雨養農業區。加入歐盟、阿爾克瓦水壩完工後，大量的水被送進來，政府也劃好了官方灌區。可是外來投資者在灌區邊界外買地、接水，種起密集的果園，被稱為「precários」，也就是沒有正式身分的用水戶。他們原本是局外人，卻因為已經在用水，一步步被承認、被納入。灌區的邊界不是畫好就固定，而是被資本和既成事實推著往外走。
story_en: Alentejo in southern Portugal used to be a dry region of rain-fed farming. After EU membership and the completion of the Alqueva dam, large volumes of water arrived and the government drew official irrigation perimeters. Outside investors then bought land just beyond those borders, connected to the water and planted intensive orchards; locally they are called 'precários', irrigators without formal status. They started as outsiders, but because they were already using water, they were gradually recognised and absorbed into the system. The lesson for me is that an irrigation boundary is not fixed once it is drawn: capital and facts on the ground keep pushing it outward.
note: Atlas/🇵🇹 Alqueva – Irrigation Expansion by Outsiders.md

sources.text: Rap, E. et al. (2026). When outsiders become insiders [course reading, Wageningen University].

title_en: Satellites Misread the Nile Delta's Water Use
title_zh: 被衛星誤讀的三角洲用水
story_zh: 在埃及，研究者用衛星遙測模型（SEBAL）估算每一塊田的蒸發散。尼羅河三角洲的數值很高，被解讀成「用水沒效率」，於是有人建議訓練農民省水，並把水送到沙漠的新墾區，因為那裡的灌溉看起來更有效率。但三角洲在流域的下游，田裡多出來的水會流回渠道和排水系統，被下一塊田再用一次。一個像素看起來的浪費，放到整個流域，可能根本不是浪費。
story_en: In Egypt, researchers used a satellite model (SEBAL) to estimate evapotranspiration field by field. The Nile Delta showed high values, which were read as inefficient water use. The advice that followed was to train delta farmers to save water and to send more water to new desert schemes, where irrigation looked more efficient. But the delta sits at the downstream end of the basin: water that leaves one field returns to canals and drains and is used again by the next. What looks like waste in a single pixel may not be waste at all at the scale of the basin, and comparing delta rice with desert orchards is not a fair comparison to begin with.
note: Atlas/🇪🇬 Nile Delta – Misreading Satellite ET.md

sources.text: Molle, F., Gaafar, I., El-Agha, D. E., & Rap, E. (2018). The Nile delta's water and salt balances and implications for management. Agricultural Water Management, 197, 110–121.
Tawfik, M., Hoogesteger, J., Moussa, M., & Hellegers, P. (2024). 'Squeezing out' the Nile Delta's drainage water to irrigate Egypt's desert land. Water, 16(1), 157.

title_en: Family Farm Plans Against Hillside Erosion
title_zh: 用家庭農場計畫對抗坡地沖蝕
story_zh: 蒲隆地人口密集，農民只能在陡峭的坡地上耕作，土壤一年年被雨水沖走。2014 年起，基特加等省推動「整合農場規劃」（PIP）：全家人一起畫出農場現在的樣子和三到五年後想要的樣子，再一起訂計畫，挖等高溝、種樹、做堆肥。計畫不發錢、不發糧，而是讓先做的農民教鄰居，最後整個村子一起動起來。影響研究發現，農場種樹的比例從約三成提高到九成以上。
story_en: Burundi is densely populated, and many farmers have no choice but to cultivate steep hillsides that lose soil to the rain every year. Since 2014, the Integrated Farm Planning (PIP) approach has been introduced in provinces such as Gitega. The whole family draws their farm as it is today and as they want it to be in three to five years, then agrees on a plan: contour trenches, trees, compost pits, a vegetable garden. There is no cash or food for work; instead, the first farmers become trainers for their neighbours, until the whole village takes collective action. An impact study found that the share of farms with planted trees rose from about 30% to over 90%. What strikes me is that the starting point is not technology but motivation.
note: Atlas/🇧🇮 Burundi – Hillside Soil Degradation.md

sources.text: Kessler, A., Reemst, L., Beun, M., Slingerland, E., Pol, L., & De Winne, R. (2021). Mobilizing farmers to stop land degradation: A different discourse from Burundi. Land Degradation & Development, 32(12), 3403–3414.

title_en: Hidden Agri-Food Losses under Climate Risk
title_zh: 氣候風險下看不見的農業損失
story_zh: 臺灣的農業災損紀錄，是為了行政補償而設計的：颱風或寒害來了、農民申報、官員現勘，損失才被看見。但高溫讓稻穗出現空包彈、米粒出現腹白，這種緩慢的衰退很少被記錄。公糧收購讓農民撐過單次災害，卻也讓大家更難離開水稻；補償的紅利常落在地主身上，風險卻由實際耕作的人承擔。短期的安全網，長期下來反而可能讓整個農業系統更脆弱。
story_en: In Taiwan, farm losses are recorded by a system built for compensation rather than for understanding risk. When a typhoon hits, farmers report damage, officials inspect the fields, and the loss becomes visible. But rising heat can leave rice grains empty or lower their quality, and this slow decline is rarely counted. Government rice purchasing protects farmers from single disasters, yet it also makes it harder to move away from rice. Over time, short-term safety can turn into long-term vulnerability.
note: Output/Projects/Taiwan Agricultural Risk and Policy

title_en: Cornered Into Cooperation
title_zh: 被絕境逼出來的團結
story_zh: 富里在花蓮和台東的交界，是許多資源最後才抵達的地方。這裡有不少新住民，也有當年在別處爭不到落腳處、最後才遷來的人；坡地脆弱，不少農田建在河床上，還曾面對垃圾掩埋場這類建設的進逼。被逼到這樣的處境，人們只能團結，也因此長出很強的農民組織：在農會與產銷班的合作下，有機稻農幾乎不必負擔保費，就能投保保障更多的水稻保險。天賜糧源（MANNAFOODS）替每一戶畫出代表家的符碼，用穀稻秋聲音樂祭把外面的音樂和文化帶進來，也讓在地居民的表演被看見。富里種出的不只是有機米，而是一個更有機的地方。
story_en: Fuli sits on the border between Hualien and Taitung, the place where many resources, tangible or not, arrive last. Many residents are new immigrants, or families who moved here after failing to secure a place elsewhere; the slopes are fragile, many fields were built on riverbeds, and the township has faced unwanted projects such as a landfill. Pushed into such a vulnerable position, people had to unite, and Fuli now has remarkably strong farmers' organisations: through cooperation between the farmers' association and production groups, organic rice farmers can buy enhanced rice insurance while paying almost nothing themselves. MANNAFOODS designed an emblem for every household and uses an autumn harvest music festival to bring outside music and culture in, while giving local residents a stage of their own. What Fuli grows is not only organic rice, but a more organic place.
note: 大學：青年壯遊 A039（2022）；Herman 的口述回顧（20 歲的故事）

sources.text: 餓・拾穗 (2022). 花東永續生活與慢食踏訪：成果報告書. 教育部青年發展署 111 年青年壯遊臺灣－尋找感動地圖實踐計畫 (A039).

title_en: Landslides Meet an Aging Mountain Town
title_zh: 崩塌遇上高齡化的山城
story_zh: 烏來位在新北市最南端，大部分坡度超過三十度，年雨量三到四千毫米，颱風一來就容易崩塌。2015 年蘇迪勒颱風在烏來全區引發大量崩塌，老街的溫泉區停業數月，觀光收入驟減。我們用 SINMAP 模擬坡地的穩定度，再分析歷年的社會脆弱度，發現老化指數和扶養比快速上升，正一點一點削弱這裡面對災害的能力。災害風險不只來自地形，也來自一個社會怎麼變老。
story_en: Wulai lies at the southern tip of New Taipei, where most slopes are steeper than 30 degrees and annual rainfall reaches 3,000 to 4,000 mm. In 2015, Typhoon Soudelor triggered landslides across almost the whole district, and the hot-spring old street had to close for months. In a group project, we modelled slope stability with SINMAP and analysed how social vulnerability changed over the years. We found that a rapidly rising ageing index and dependency ratio are steadily weakening the town's capacity to cope with disasters. Disaster risk here comes not only from the terrain, but also from how a society grows old.
note: 大學：烏來地區自然災害脆弱性之時空分析（小組報告）

sources.text: Group 3 (2024). 烏來地區自然災害脆弱性之時空分析：環境與社會變遷之綜合評估. Group course report, Department of Geography, National Taiwan University.

title_en: Plants Clinging to a Conglomerate Badland
title_zh: 在礫岩惡地夾縫求生的植物
story_zh: 高雄六龜的十八羅漢山是礫岩惡地，岩壁陡峭，雨水一沖就崩落，植物很難生根。我用 Google Earth Engine 比較 1990、2005 和 2019 年的 NDVI，看到不同區段的植被有增有減，莫拉克風災後河道改變，舊河床上也長出新的植被。保護區管理人力不足、調查資料多年沒有更新；林務局想保育，在地居民想靠觀光重振經濟，雙方卻缺乏對話。惡地上的植物能不能留下來，最後取決於人怎麼談。
story_en: The Eighteen Arhats Mountain in Liugui, Kaohsiung, is a conglomerate badland: steep rock walls crumble with every heavy rain, and plants struggle to take root. Using Google Earth Engine, I compared NDVI in 1990, 2005 and 2019 and saw vegetation gaining in some sections and losing in others; after Typhoon Morakot shifted the river, new vegetation even grew on the old riverbed. The nature reserve is short of staff, and its survey data have not been updated for years. The forestry bureau wants conservation, local residents hope tourism can revive the economy, and the two sides rarely talk. Whether plants can hold on to this badland depends, in the end, on how people negotiate.
note: 大學：十八羅漢間夾縫求生：礫岩惡地之於植被保護的挑戰（2023）

sources.text: Ho, C.-W. (2023). 十八羅漢間夾縫求生：礫岩惡地之於植被保護的挑戰. Course report, Department of Geography, National Taiwan University.

title_en: Groundwater Pumping Sinks a Fishing Village
title_zh: 抽地下水抽沉的漁村
story_zh: 屏東佳冬的塭豐村，魚塭一座座高出地面，像架高的游泳池。過去為了養殖用水，居民大量抽取地下水，含水層得不到足夠的補注，土地一年年往下陷。實察那天看到，許多民房已經陷下將近一層樓高，新房子只能加裝擋水閘門、做斜坡。站在海堤上，堤內和堤外的高低差一目了然，未來還可能面對海水入侵和土壤鹽化。這裡有很高的產值，卻也一直在跟土地討價還價。
story_en: In Wenfeng Village, Jiadong, Pingtung, fishponds rise above the ground like elevated swimming pools. For years, residents pumped large amounts of groundwater for aquaculture, and because the aquifer was not recharged enough, the land kept sinking. On our field trip we saw houses that had sunk by almost a full storey, while new houses were built with flood gates and ramps. Standing on the sea dike, the height difference between the land inside and the sea outside is plain to see, and seawater intrusion and soil salinisation may follow. This is a place of high economic value that is constantly bargaining with its own land.
note: 大學：地形學實察筆記（2022）

sources.text: Ho, C.-W. (2022). 地形學實察筆記：屏東佳冬塭豐村. Field notes, Geomorphology field course, National Taiwan University.

title_en: A Bypassed Village That Learned to Stand Alone
title_zh: 被省道繞過後學會自立的社區
story_zh: 鹿野永安村過去就在舊台九線上，後來被截彎取直的省道繞過，開闢近百年的武陵綠色隧道變得人跡罕至，咖啡產銷班的咖啡也賣不出去。這裡有許多軍眷後代，信念很有感染力，也很獨立：居民在極少的預算下辦起咖啡節，後來發展成東台灣最大的農村市集「2626 市集」，攤位要環保、有機，營運靠社區公共基金，不靠政府補助。社區裡處處是手作的智慧，用石頭疊成的清水生態設施、用廢棄物做成的地景裝置，都是自己動手的成果。
story_en: Yongan Village in Luye once sat on the old Provincial Highway 9, until the straightened highway bypassed it; the century-old Wuling Green Tunnel was almost forgotten, and local coffee farmers struggled to sell their beans. Many residents are descendants of military families, and their convictions are contagious and fiercely independent. On a very small budget they started a coffee festival, which grew into the 2626 Market, the largest rural market in eastern Taiwan: stalls must be eco-friendly and organic, and the market runs on a community fund rather than government subsidies. Handmade wisdom is everywhere, from stone-built structures that keep the streams clean to landscape art made from discarded objects.
note: 大學：青年壯遊 A039（2022）四-6；Herman 的口述回顧（20 歲的故事）

sources.text: 餓・拾穗 (2022). 花東永續生活與慢食踏訪：成果報告書. 教育部青年發展署 111 年青年壯遊臺灣－尋找感動地圖實踐計畫 (A039).

title_en: A Hakka Town Where Slow Food Takes Root
title_zh: 慢食在客家小鎮紮根
story_zh: 花蓮鳳林是以客家人為主的小鎮，地方組織緊密，加上客家族群團結的文化，大家在同一個議題上比較容易形成共識，慢食和永續的理念也因此推得動。拾豆屋的老闆是返鄉青年，自己種黃豆、做豆花和豆漿，和其他豆農組成合作社，店裡的收入用來支持青年培力工作站，讓返鄉和移居的年輕人有落地生根的地方。他說，鳳林的「慢」要真的住下來才懂。在這裡我看到，一個地方的人和文化，會決定它的農業長成什麼樣子。
story_en: Fenglin in Hualien is a predominantly Hakka town. Local organisations are tightly knit and the Hakka community is known for its solidarity, so people reach consensus on shared issues more easily, which helps ideas like slow food and sustainability take root. The owner of 拾豆屋 came back to his hometown to grow soybeans and make tofu pudding and soy milk; he formed a cooperative with other soybean farmers, and the shop's income supports a youth station that helps young people who return or move here settle down. For him, Fenglin's 'slow' is something you only understand after living here. Fenglin showed me how the people and culture of a place shape what its agriculture becomes.
note: 大學：青年壯遊 A039（2022）四-10；Herman 的口述回顧（20 歲的故事）

sources.text: 餓・拾穗 (2022). 花東永續生活與慢食踏訪：成果報告書. 教育部青年發展署 111 年青年壯遊臺灣－尋找感動地圖實踐計畫 (A039).

title_en: Urban Farms Planted for Show
title_zh: 種給誰看的田園城市
story_zh: 1960 年代末，臺北市還有七千多公頃的農地，到了 2023 年只剩不到兩千八百公頃。2014 年起的田園城市政策在全市開闢了 751 處田園基地，看起來成果豐碩。但我用空間分析檢查可近性，排除校園、社宅、大樓和綠屋頂之後，只剩 254 處是一般市民真正走得進去的，大約三分之一。田園城市是種給誰吃，還是種給誰看？真正能參與的農園，應該回到街角空地和社區綠帶。
story_en: In the late 1960s, Taipei still had more than 7,000 hectares of farmland; by 2023 less than 2,800 hectares remained. Since 2014, the city's Garden City policy has created 751 urban farm sites, which looks like a success on paper. But when I checked their accessibility with spatial analysis and removed sites inside schools, social housing, private buildings and green roofs, only 254 remained that ordinary residents could actually walk into, about one third. So who are these gardens for: people who eat from them, or people who look at them? Truly participatory urban farms, I argue, belong on street-corner plots and community green belts.
note: 大學：種給誰看？臺北田園城市的空間幻象與參與結構

sources.text: Ho, C.-W. (2025). 種給誰看？臺北田園城市的空間幻象與參與結構. Course report, Department of Geography, National Taiwan University.

title_en: Offshore Wind Caught Between Localization and Cheap Power
title_zh: 夾在國產化與低電價之間的離岸風電
story_zh: 台灣海峽的強風，讓彰化外海成為離岸風電的重要基地。2024 年的課堂演講讓我看到，風機能不能轉起來，不只看風，也看政策和資金。政府推動國產化，想培養本地供應鏈，卻引來歐盟向 WTO 提出爭端諮商，允能風場的滑樁事件也暴露出技術落差。風場融資大多靠國際銀行，而台灣電價長期偏低，企業不願買較貴的綠電，開發商就更難找到長期購電合約。能源轉型的瓶頸，常常不在海上。
story_en: Strong winds in the Taiwan Strait have turned the waters off Changhua into a hub for offshore wind. A 2024 lecture showed me that whether the turbines turn depends not only on wind, but on policy and money. Taiwan's push to localise the supply chain led the EU to request WTO dispute consultations, and a pile-sliding incident at the Yunneng wind farm exposed technical gaps. Most project finance comes from international banks, while Taiwan's long-standing low electricity prices make companies reluctant to buy more expensive green power, so developers struggle to secure long-term purchase contracts. The bottlenecks of the energy transition are often not at sea at all.
note: 大學：離岸風力發電導論 心得報告：風能政策（2024/12/12）

sources.text: Ho, C.-W. (2024). 風能政策：演講心得報告. Introduction to Offshore Wind Power (course), National Taiwan University.

title_en: Post-Soviet Cities Living on Imported Meat
title_zh: 經濟轉型後靠進口肉的城市
story_zh: 在中亞的塔吉克，城市並不是因為經濟起飛而長大。蘇聯解體後，國家經歷了一段漫長的經濟轉型，農村逐漸衰退，人們往城市移動，城市的糧食也越來越依賴進口和跨國零售商。今天，塔吉克城市餐桌上有很大一部分的肉，來自國外。城市人口增加了，蛋白質的來源卻沒有跟著在地長出來，而是寄託在國際市場的價格與供應上。都市化，不一定伴隨更強的在地糧食系統。
story_en: In Tajikistan, cities did not grow mainly because the economy was booming. After the Soviet Union collapsed, the country went through a long economic transition, rural areas declined, and people moved to cities. Urban food supply came to depend more and more on imports and international retailers. Today, a large share of the meat on urban tables in Tajikistan comes from abroad. As cities grow, their protein supply is tied to global markets rather than to local farms.

sources.text: Asadov, S. (2013). Food security and the agricultural cooperation agenda in Central Asia with a focus on Tajikistan. SSRN.
Liefert, W. M., Serova, E., & Liefert, O. (2010). The growing importance of the former USSR countries in world agricultural markets. Agricultural Economics, 41, 65–71.

note: Literature on urban food systems (bachelor thesis reading)

title_en: Pseudo-Urbanization without Better Diets
title_zh: 假性都市化下的單調餐桌
story_zh: 在西非的幾內亞比索，城市的擴張和自然資源的開採緊緊綁在一起。人口往城市聚集，但道路、冷藏和市場這些基礎設施沒有跟上，城市裡能買到的食物種類非常有限。研究發現，這裡的城市飲食仍以澱粉類主食和加工食品為主，蛋白質的攝取一直偏低。城市長大了，餐桌卻沒有變得更豐富。都市化帶來什麼，不只取決於有多少人搬進城市，也取決於城市是怎麼長出來的。
story_en: In Guinea-Bissau, urban growth has been closely tied to the extraction of natural resources. People moved into cities, but roads, cold storage and markets did not keep pace. As a result, the food available in urban areas remains limited in variety. Studies found that urban diets are still dominated by staple carbohydrates and processed foods, and protein intake stays low. A growing city does not automatically mean a richer table; it depends on how the city grows.

sources.text: Patsche, C. B., Rudolf, F., Da Silva Mendes, A. M., Da Cunha, I., Gomes, V. F., Wejse, C., & Jeppesen, C. (2019). Dietary intake in undernourished adults living in Guinea-Bissau: A cross-sectional study. BMC Nutrition, 5, 13.

note: Literature on urban food systems (bachelor thesis reading)

title_en: Unstable Food Access without a Cold Chain
title_zh: 缺乏冷鏈下不穩定的食物取得
story_zh: 在多哥首都洛美，想在城市裡穩定地吃到肉、魚或蛋，並不容易。這裡缺乏冷藏運輸的冷鏈，也缺少大規模的供應系統，許多家庭只能在露天市場和街頭攤販購買動物性蛋白質，品質和供應都時有時無。在洛美，營養能不能送到城市居民手上，關鍵不只是有沒有錢，而是有沒有一條能把食物保持新鮮的路。城市的飲食，往往取決於那些我們平常看不見的物流。
story_en: In Lomé, the capital of Togo, getting a steady supply of meat, fish or eggs in the city is not easy. There is little cold-chain infrastructure to keep food chilled, and few large-scale suppliers. Many households buy animal-source protein from open-air stalls and street vendors. As a result, both the quality and the availability of protein can change from day to day. Here, whether nutrition reaches city residents depends not only on money, but on a path that keeps food fresh.

sources.text: Toumoudagou N’oueni, P., Zinsou-Klassou, K., & Chenal, J. (2024). State of food and nutritional security of urban households in Grand Lomé: Approach by measuring household indicators. Foods, 13, 3345.

note: Literature on urban food systems (bachelor thesis reading)

title_en: Foreign Capital Brings the Cold Chain
title_zh: 外資帶來的超市與冷鏈
story_zh: 同樣在非洲，納米比亞的城市走出了另一條路。來自南非的外資和連鎖超市大量進駐，連北部的中小型城鎮也出現了超市，研究者稱之為「第二波超市革命」。超市背後是一整套冷藏運輸的冷鏈，讓肉、乳製品和蛋能穩定且多樣地送到城市居民手上。把它和多哥放在一起看，就能看見一座城市吃得好不好，常常取決於投資和物流這些看不見的條件。
story_en: Elsewhere in Africa, Namibia's cities took a different path. Foreign investment and supermarket chains, especially from South Africa, have spread even into smaller towns in the north, a shift researchers call a secondary supermarket revolution. Behind these supermarkets is an integrated cold chain that keeps meat, dairy and eggs chilled. This makes protein supply in Namibian cities more reliable and more diverse. Compared with Togo, it shows how much a city's diet depends on investment and logistics we rarely see.

sources.text: Crush, J., & Frayne, B. (2011). Supermarket expansion and the informal food economy in Southern African cities: Implications for urban food security. Journal of Southern African Studies, 37, 781–807.
Kazembe, L., Crush, J., & Nickanor, N. (2022). Secondary supermarket revolution: Food sources and food security in Northern Namibia. Urban Transformations, 4, 14.

note: Literature on urban food systems (bachelor thesis reading)

title_en: NAFTA Reshapes Mexico's Protein Diet
title_zh: 自由貿易改變了墨西哥人的飲食
story_zh: 墨西哥人吃的肉變多了，但原因不全是收入提高。北美自由貿易協定（NAFTA）上路後，大量的玉米和牛肉進口，國內生產也跟著重新調整，肉、乳製品和蛋變得更便宜，傳統的豆類卻越吃越少。但這份豐富並沒有平均分配：許多城市貧困家庭要花一半以上的收入在食物上，價格一波動就首當其衝。結果，營養不良和肥胖同時出現在同一座城市裡。
story_en: People in Mexico eat more meat than before, but not mainly because incomes rose. After the North American Free Trade Agreement (NAFTA), large imports of maize and beef reshaped the food system, making meat, dairy and eggs cheaper. Meanwhile, traditional beans and other legumes slowly disappeared from the table. Yet many poor urban households still spend more than half of their income on food and are hit hardest when prices swing. Undernutrition and obesity now exist side by side in the same cities.

sources.text: Sánchez-Ortiz, N. A., Unar-Munguía, M., Bautista-Arredondo, S., Shamah-Levy, T., & Colchero, M. A. (2022). Changes in apparent consumption of staple food in Mexico associated with the gradual implementation of the NAFTA. PLOS Global Public Health.
Cruz-Sánchez, Y. (2024). The availability of food in Mexico: An approach to measuring food security. Agriculture & Food Security, 13.
Romo-Aviles, M. (2018). Energy and nutrient supply according to food insecurity severity among Mexican households. Food Security.

note: Literature on urban food systems (bachelor thesis reading)

title_en: Export-First Farming Leaves Staples Behind
title_zh: 出口優先下停滯的主食
story_zh: 巴西是全球領先的大豆出口國，國家的蛋白質供應也隨著農業擴張一起增加。但土地和資源大量轉向出口作物，米、豆子和樹薯這些傳統主食的生產反而停滯，甚至減少。食物變貴、貧富差距又大，許多城市家庭只能改買比較便宜的雞肉、雞蛋和超加工食品。巴西曾用家庭補助金（Bolsa Família）等計畫來縮小落差，但近年政策支持轉弱。出口的豐收，並沒有自動變成每個家庭的營養。
story_en: Brazil has become a global leader in soybean exports, and its national protein supply has grown alongside agricultural expansion. But as land and resources shifted toward export crops, production of traditional staples like rice, beans and cassava stalled or even declined. With rising food prices and deep income inequality, many urban families turned to cheaper chicken, eggs and ultra-processed foods. Programmes such as Bolsa Família once helped narrow the gap, but policy support has weakened in recent years. An export boom does not automatically become nutrition on every family's table.

sources.text: Souza, R. M. D., & Ribeiro, J. C. (2025). The impact of Brazil’s agricultural export boom on domestic food security. Law and Economy, 4, 38–47.

Levy, R. B., Andrade, G. C., Cruz, G. L. D., Rauber, F., Louzada, M. L. D. C., Claro, R. M., & Monteiro, C. A. (2022). Three decades of household food availability according to NOVA – Brazil, 1987–2018. Revista de Saúde Pública, 56, 75.

note: Literature on urban food systems (bachelor thesis reading)

title_en: Export Controls That Failed to Feed Cities
title_zh: 沒讓城市吃得更好的出口管制
story_zh: 阿根廷是高度都市化的國家。為了讓城市居民買得起食物，政府長期對小麥和牛肉等農產品設下出口配額、課徵出口稅，希望把國內價格壓低。但這個保護措施反而削弱了它想守護的供應系統：農民拿到的價格太低、法規又反覆變動，於是減少了小麥和牛肉的生產。到了 2014 年，食物價格幾乎和通膨同步上漲。全國的蛋白質總量其實足夠，城市裡的窮人卻越來越吃不起富含蛋白質的飲食。
story_en: Argentina is a highly urbanised country, and to keep food affordable for city residents, the government has long used export quotas and taxes on products like wheat and beef. The goal was to hold down domestic prices. Instead, the policy weakened the very supply system it was meant to protect. With low farmgate prices and constantly changing rules, farmers cut back on wheat and beef production. By 2014, food prices were rising almost as fast as inflation, and protein-rich diets slipped out of reach for the urban poor.

sources.text: Feeney, R., & MacClay, P. (2016). Food security in Argentina: A production or distribution problem? International Food and Agribusiness Management Review, 19.

note: Literature on urban food systems (bachelor thesis reading)

title_en: An Aging Society Reshapes Japan's Diet
title_zh: 高齡化改變的飲食組成
story_zh: 在日本，住在城市的人口比例過去二十年持續上升，全國的蛋白質供應卻維持持平，甚至略微下降。這背後是一個正在變老的社會：年長的日本人吃比較少的雞肉，吃更多的魚和黃豆製品，更貼近傳統的飲食習慣。國家的飲食指南也開始強調健康地變老，鼓勵適量攝取蛋白質，重視品質、好消化，以及來自植物的蛋白質。在這裡，吃多少已經不是重點，怎麼吃得剛剛好，才是高齡社會的課題。
story_en: In Japan, the share of people living in cities has kept rising over the past two decades, yet the national protein supply has stayed flat or even declined slightly. Behind this is an aging society. Older Japanese people eat less chicken and more fish and soy foods, staying close to traditional diets. National dietary guidelines now emphasise healthy aging, encouraging moderate protein intake with attention to quality, digestibility and plant-based sources. In an aging society, the question is no longer how much to eat, but how to eat just right.

sources.text: Nomura, M., Yamaguchi, M., Inada, Y., & Nishi, N. (2023). Current dietary intake of the Japanese population in reference to the planetary health diet – preliminary assessment. Frontiers in Nutrition, 10, 1116105.

note: Literature on urban food systems (bachelor thesis reading)

title_en: Mediterranean Diet in Aging Spain
title_zh: 高齡化下的地中海飲食
story_zh: 西班牙同樣是一個快速都市化、也快速老化的社會。1970 年代，西班牙人的肉類消費快速成長，到了 1980 年代卻趨於平穩，這被視為文化偏好和健康意識開始比經濟更能左右飲食的早期訊號。今天，世代之間的餐桌出現分歧：年長者仍保有以豆類、魚和橄欖油為主的傳統飲食，年輕的城市世代卻逐漸離開地中海飲食，轉向加工食品和紅肉。在西班牙，決定吃什麼的已經不只是收入，還有年紀和文化。
story_en: Spain is a society that is both urbanising and aging quickly. Meat consumption rose rapidly through the 1970s but levelled off in the 1980s, an early sign that culture and health awareness had started to matter more than income alone. Today, a generational divide shows up at the table. Older adults keep a traditional diet built on legumes, fish and olive oil, while younger urban people are drifting away from the Mediterranean diet toward processed foods and red meat. In Spain, what people eat is shaped not only by income, but by age and culture.

sources.text: Delgado, P. (2023). From affluence to processed food: Meat consumption in Spain from 1950 to the present. Historia Agraria.

Partearroyo, T., Samaniego-Vaesken, M. D. L., Ruiz, E., Aranceta-Bartrina, J., Gil, Á., González-Gross, M., Ortega, R. M., Serra-Majem, L., & Varela-Moreiras, G. (2019). Current food consumption amongst the Spanish ANIBES study population. Nutrients, 11, 2663.

note: Literature on urban food systems (bachelor thesis reading)
